instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the Autodesk EAGLE graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ULP scripts, command-line automation, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only EAGLE native GUI tools, menus, and built-in save/export commands. Look at `mixed.sch`, add a zero-ohm resistor named `R_TIE` that bridges `AGND` and `DGND`, and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch` must parse as well-formed XML. 2. A `<part name="R_TIE">` must exist. 3. The `AGND` net must contain `<pinref part="R_TIE" pin="1"/>`. 4. The `DGND` net must contain `<pinref part="R_TIE" pin="2"/>`. 5. `C1` and `C2` must remain connected to `AGND`. 6. `R1` and `R2` must remain connected to `DGND`. 7. `AGND` and `DGND` must remain separate nets.
